⚡ 03 — Session Architecture

ℹ️ V14 session architecture: CARDIO WARM-UP → DYNAMIC MOBILITY → ACTIVATION → MAIN WORKOUT → CARDIO FINISHER → STATIC COOL-DOWN. Warm-up intensity and movement selection are adaptive to Level + Goal + Training Type + Home/Gym. Every phase has a Smart Timer with work, transition/rest and rounds.

🎚️ 04B — V14 Smart Training Controls

V14 adapts exercise selection, volume, work time, rest, cardio demand and progression from level, goal, experience, equipment, duration, recovery and previous feedback. 15 min uses a compact session architecture designed to stay short while keeping the exercise flow coherent.

MUSCLE

LOCATION

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS

WHAT THIS MUSCLE DOES

ARCHITECTURE

ORIGIN → INSERTION

WHAT IT IS MADE OF

Skeletal muscle is organized from whole muscle → fascicles → muscle fibers → myofibrils → sarcomeres. Sarcomeres contain actin and myosin filaments. The fibers also contain mitochondria, sarcoplasmic reticulum, T-tubules, connective tissue and metabolic enzymes that support force production and recovery.

FROM NERVE SIGNAL TO FORCE

Motor neuron→Acetylcholine→Action potential→Ca²⁺ release→Actin–myosin interaction→Force

CONCENTRIC

ECCENTRIC

ISOMETRIC

KEY IDEA

Contraction does not simply mean “shortening.” Muscle fibers can produce force while shortening, lengthening under load, or holding approximately the same joint position.

JOINT ACTION

LEVER / POSITION

BIOMECHANICAL LESSON

ATP

ATP is the immediate chemical energy currency used by cross-bridge cycling and other cellular work. The muscle continuously regenerates ATP from phosphocreatine, glycolysis and oxidative phosphorylation.

MITOCHONDRIA

HOW MITOCHONDRIAL CAPACITY CAN INCREASE

Repeated exercise can stimulate mitochondrial biogenesis and improve oxidative capacity. Endurance-oriented work is a strong stimulus; resistance training also creates metabolic adaptations, especially when volume and local muscular demand are sufficient. Adaptation depends on training dose, recovery, nutrition, genetics and the muscle’s starting condition.
